name: sun
description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested a trial of longer Sun rays on2026-10-27. Each ray is3px long measured to the visible rounded ends at native24px and Regular1.70: centerline length1.30, spanning radial distance7.90..9.20, plus .85 caps at each end. Extend only the inner endpoint by.30; preserve the outer tips, disc radius5.10 (Filled5.95), stroke1.70, native X/Y100%, rotation0 and equal margins1.95. Filled rays are exact radius-.85 capsules around the same centerlines. The Sun Moon morph derives its Sun endpoint from this source automatically. Owner approved this3px visible ray-length revision in both styles on2026-10-27 and requested the morph use the same Sun. All20 current pairs are approved. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner explicitly approved Sun on2026-10-27 with3px visible rounded rays, unchanged disc and Regular1.70. The Sun Moon morph must use these exact rays at its Sun endpoint in both directions and both styles. Native X/Y100%, rotation0.
